$comment: Unreachable source files per package. Regenerate with `bun run scripts/dead-modules.ts --update` and review the diff. Ratchet: any increase fails CI. `allow` holds files reachable only by a mechanism the resolver cannot see (string keys, runtime paths) — each needs a reason, not just a path. An allowed file is treated as an ENTRY, so whatever it imports is reachable too.

allow.packages/crdt-yjs/src/worker-entry.ts: tsdown entry (tsdown.config.ts:7), loaded by string path at src/worker-engine.ts:151
allow.packages/sandbox/src/guest-entry.ts: shipped as source via package.json `files`, executed by Deno through a string path; deliberately outside tsc
allow.packages/sandbox/src/sandbox-server.ts: same as guest-entry — Deno executes it by path, not by import
allow.packages/tanstack-db/src/tanstack-contra: no importers by design; tsconfig `include` picks it up so `check-types` compiles it as a contract check
